page.layout: One page of text in a single column. Running head centred at top ("שכ"), page number top right. Entries are Hebrew roots with Latin glosses and Scripture citations; the Hebrew headwords stand out large at the left margin. No marginal notes. Catchword "Ten-" at bottom right.

main_text.p: tum, Levit.26.1. Aff. בחדרי משכיתו In conclavibus pictu-rae fuae, hoc est, figuratis, Ezech.8.12. במשכיתו In imagina-tione vel cogitatione ejus, Prov.18.11. R. Levi: Plur. משכיות לבב Imaginationes cordis, Psal.73.7. כסף במשכיות Cum figuris argenteis, Prov.25.11. Affix: כל־משכיתם Omnes effi-gies ipsorum, Num.33.52.
main_text.head: שכח
main_text.p: Oblivisci: Construitur ab oblui & cum Acti-vo: Praeterit. ושכח את־יהוה Et obli-viscaris Domini Dei tui, Deut.8.14. השכחתם את רעות An obliti estis malorum, Jerem.44.9. Niph. Praeterit. כי נשכח זכרם Nam oblivioni tradita est memoria ipso-rum, Eccles.9.5. Pih. Praeterit. שכח Omnino ob-liviscitur Dominus, Thren.2.6. vel, Obliviſci fecit, Psal. est oblivioni dari. Hiph. Infinit. להשכיח את־שמי Ad obliviſci faciendum populum meum nominis mei, Jer. 23.v.27. Hithp. Futur. ישתכח Et oblivioni tradentur, Eccles.8.10.
שכח Oblivifcens, Oblitus: Plural. השכחים את־הר קדשי Obliviſcentes montis sanctitatis mea, Iefa.65.v.11. Constr. שכחי אלהים Oblita Dei, Psal.9.18.

Chald. Invenire: Ithpeh. Praeterit. השתכחה Inventum est, Esr.6.2. Foem. זכו השכחת Puritas invenitur apud me, Dan.6.22. והשתכחת Et inventus es deficiens, Dan.5.27. Aphel Praeter. והשכחו Et invenerunt, Esr.4.19. להן השכחנא Nisi inveniamus, Dan.6.v.5. להשכחה Invenire, Dan.6.v.4. Futur. נהשכח Inveniemus contra Danielem, v.5. Inveniesf, Esr.4.15.
main_text.head: שכך
main_text.p: Poni, Ponere se, id est, Sedari, Quietum reddi, Quiescere. Item, Potere, Ten-

page.notes: Hebrew forms in the Chaldee and Hebrew entries are not certain at this resolution; they are copied as far as I can make them out and should be checked against the scan. The heading "Psal." was read as Psal. in the transcription. The line "Inveniesf" appears to be a printing error for Inveniesf / Invenies; left as printed. Lines in the Hebrew fragments near "Dan.6.v.4" and "Esr.4.15" are partly obscured by show-through and may be wrong.
